scope: Approved SDK prerequisites and Folders source adoption; whole-story review remains separate

findings.claim: Delayed legacy installer creates markerless scratch
findings.evidence: Parent independently reran the paused-before-operation0 probe: after compensation, marker reclamation and Abort, the old installer leaves an old envelope without its marker; RecoverPendingAsync returns invalid-recovery-evidence.

findings.claim: Optimistic transaction recovery falsely reports settlement
findings.evidence: Parent reran the supported TransactionQualified component probe: recovery reports IsResolved/WasRecovered true while the exact marker stays Prepared; ReclaimScratchReceiptAsync then throws permanently. This does not claim Redis transaction qualification.

findings.claim: Absent marker hides a retained external manifest
findings.evidence: Parent reran the canonical external-manifest crash-state probe: exact-marker recovery says resolved and ReclaimScratchReceiptAsync leaves the payload-bearing deterministic manifest. Prepare writes external manifest before marker, so this two-RPC state is reachable.

findings.claim: Ordinary conditional saves cannot replace logically expired physical wrappers
findings.evidence: Parent reproduced GetAsync returning null followed by ReadModelWritePolicy.UpdateAsync exhausting three retries against retained expired bytes. Both stores still enforce physical create-only in ordinary TrySaveAsync; their batch CreateOnly path already distinguishes logical expiry and physical CAS.

findings.claim: Production DI registration ignores the configured coordinator clock
findings.evidence: Parent resolved the default production registration with a configured clock: the registered options/store use that instance but reflection confirms the coordinator uses System. The factory still calls the original two-argument constructor, while the three-argument constructor already exists.

findings.claim: Bulk final-wrapper reads add N sequential RPCs
findings.evidence: The bulk response already contains each final wrapper and ETag. The new IsExpiring branch calls ResolveVisibleAsync per item, whose first step is a new physical accessor read; N final retained rows therefore add N sequential network reads. Direct final decoding can reuse the existing wrapper resolver without new public surface.

findings.claim: Unbounded promoted cleanup blocks later Begin calls
findings.evidence: Parent reproduced the existing promoted-cleanup fault seam with a first request that honors its cancellation token: background receives CanBeCanceled=false, two Begin callers cancel, and the shared cleanup task remains pending. Later healthy work stays behind that uncancellable task until an external release. The new wait makes this a singleton liveness regression.

findings.claim: Expired conditional candidates bypass their immutable CAS precondition
findings.evidence: Parent reproduced an already-expired Match(stale-etag) alongside a non-expiring checkpoint receiving Completed. The unchanged operation contract binds concurrency into durable identity and frozen intent preserves CAS. Expiry may omit the candidate; it must not silently discard an unproven conditional guard. An already installed original envelope remains proof of its earlier successful guard.

findings.claim: Omitted expired unconditional writes still block on foreign envelopes
findings.evidence: Parent reproduced expired LastWrite targeting a foreign Prepared envelope: Execute commits its own checkpoint, returns Indeterminate/compaction-race and leaves the checkpoint wrapped. Installation omits this operation, but staging/compaction still wait for unrelated work. Settlement must not help or mutate foreign state.

The baseline reader returns raw bytes when a reserved envelope version is unsupported; ordinary DTO deserialization can silently produce default-valued fields from the new v3 wrapper. Current guide documents SDK readers but not the required compatible-reader-before-deadline-writer order or rollback constraint. A direct guide correction suffices; deployment/publication remains excluded.

findings.claim: Failed marker CAS reread accepts a replacement fingerprint
findings.evidence: Parent reran the exact interleaving: a retained replacement completes and Abort opens the epoch between old commit read/CAS; the failed-CAS reread accepts its Completed marker, old compaction overwrites Open with Building, and the result is Indeterminate/compaction-race. The reread needs the same existing fingerprint guard as the initial read.

findings.claim: Delayed legacy CAS can undo completed Abort
findings.evidence: The separately filed claim is confirmed by the same parent reproduction: exact fence preservation is false and final phase Building. Verdict rendered individually before grouping with E1, which has the identical failed-CAS fingerprint root cause.

note: Individual verdicts precede grouping. No same-location/same-claim still-true carried row exists; all claims are new interleavings or different outcomes. Five trivial patches are retained as requirements during the higher-precedence bad-spec re-derivation.
